title: [Lean] Execute paid exponent widening and half-source addition
body:
## Summary

Three unchanged checked sources execute binary increment with paid overflow widening and join the actual updated working exponent to the fourteen-tape reusable dyadic adder. The output is the first input plus half the second input.

## Author-checked context

κ = 836330098538459/500000000000000000 = 0.001672660197076918, unchanged selected PR1094 context only.

## Scope

Exact first halt, decoded output and all-prefix represented-cell bounds. The fixed-width predecessor rejects overflow; physical widening on an independent blank-exterior working tape removes that successful-result capacity premise. Initial words, signs, workspaces and original packed-source preservation remain explicit. The real widened exponent width and numeric unary-gap time are charged. No selected global uniform cost or automatic fixed-grid caller implementation.

## Evidence and reuse

26 complete standard-only probes, nine full printed types, no diagnostics. Three exact sources /40,825 bytes reuse35 immutable public/import-derived prerequisites, including unchanged public RippleCounter and accepted reusable-output sources. Existing generic suppliers are acknowledged. No source edits or compiler replay.

## Exact adoption

Publication parent: 0fdd7d82de03e43c9e5a1000dfbcd380d1b687d2. The five selected-result, assembly, selected-source and emitter blobs match the previously checked context exactly; contextual kappa is unchanged. No accepted proof was rerun for this adoption.
